defects.title: Duplicate Operation ID & route shadowing on POST /TradeName/CheckTransliteration
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Inspect backend/api/routes/trade_name.py. Notice /CheckTransliteration is defined on line 420 and duplicated on line 772.
defects.expected_result: Endpoint defined once, returning expected_en in UPPERCASE per F17 with phonetic fallback.
defects.actual_result: FastAPI emits duplicate Operation ID warning. Line 772 is shadowed / dead code and lacks uppercase conversion.
defects.root_cause: Duplicate decorator @router.post('/CheckTransliteration') in trade_name.py lines 420 and 772.
defects.recommended_action: Remove duplicate definition at line 772 and consolidate phonetic fallback and uppercase conversion into line 420.

defects.title: UnboundLocalError 'primary_name' in register_trade_name exception handler
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Submit POST /TradeName/Register with new name while db.commit() raises an exception (e.g. concurrency collision).
defects.expected_result: Exception caught, rollback executed, clean JSON error message returned with HTTP 200 or 409.
defects.actual_result: Crash with HTTP 500 UnboundLocalError: local variable 'primary_name' referenced before assignment on line 1013.
defects.evidence: UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'primary_name' where it is not associated with a value at line 1013.
defects.root_cause: primary_name initialized inside 'if exact_matches:' on line 919. If exact_matches is empty and commit fails on line 978, primary_name is unassigned when line 1013 executes.
defects.recommended_action: Initialize primary_name and primary_name_ar at top of register_trade_name handler (before database checks).

defects.title: Reviewer Brief persistence failure due to missing transaction commit in brief_worker.py
defects.expected_result: Reviewer brief generated and committed to ReviewerBrief table, retrieved with HTTP 200.
defects.actual_result: GET /TradeName/ReviewerBrief/{requestId} returns HTTP 404 Not Found because brief_worker.py flushes without commit.
defects.evidence: HTTP 404: Reviewer brief for request ID 'QA-BRIEF-...' not found.
defects.root_cause: generate_brief calls await self.session.flush() instead of commit(), and ValidateWithSuggestion does not commit transaction before session close.
defects.recommended_action: Add await self.session.commit() inside generate_brief and record_decision in brief_worker.py.

defects.title: Windows AppLocker policy blocks Cython .pyd files in SQLAlchemy and PyMuPDF
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Run python imports in user directory without pure-python fallback.
defects.expected_result: Compiled extensions load or fall back to pure-Python equivalents automatically.
defects.actual_result: ImportError: DLL load failed: An Application Control policy has blocked this file.
defects.env: Windows 11 / Windows Server with WDAC / AppLocker
defects.evidence: ImportError: DLL load failed while importing _cache_key_cy
defects.root_cause: Unsigned or user-profile .pyd DLLs restricted by enterprise Windows Application Control policy.
defects.recommended_action: Disable Cython compiled .pyd in SQLAlchemy site-packages to engage pure Python .py files or sign DLLs.

defects.title: Field-level validation gap: ValidateRequest accepts empty strings for NameAr and NameEn
defects.expected_result: Rejected at schema level with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity ('String should have at least 1 character').
defects.actual_result: HTTP 200 returned, pipeline proceeds to invoke LLM analyzer and triggers unnecessary token consumption.
defects.evidence: Status 200 with decision='NEEDS_REVIEW' after wasting LLM tokens on empty strings
defects.root_cause: ValidateRequest fields NameAr and NameEn defined as str = Field(...) without min_length=1.
defects.recommended_action: Add min_length=1 to NameAr and NameEn fields in ValidateRequest schema.

defects.title: Frontend Oxlint warnings for React purity and useEffect setState calls
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Run 'npm run lint' in frontend directory.
defects.expected_result: Zero linter warnings across React components.
defects.actual_result: 15 warnings: Math.random() in useState initial state (ValidationTab.jsx), synchronous setState in useEffect.
defects.evidence: react(purity): Cannot call impure function during render (ValidationTab.jsx:52)
defects.root_cause: Math.random() evaluated directly in useState initializer rather than lazy initializer function or useEffect.
defects.recommended_action: Use lazy initial state () => `UAQ-REQ-${...}` and ensure useEffect dependencies are sanitized.

defects.title: NameComposer appends English legal form to Arabic name and fails to strip Arabic legal form token during amendment
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Call compose(name_ar='شركة النور ذ.م.م', name_en='Al Noor Co LLC', operation_type='legal_form_amend', old_legal_form='LLC', new_legal_form='Sole Proprietorship').
defects.expected_result: Old Arabic legal form 'ذ.م.م' stripped and Arabic new legal form applied; no English string appended to Arabic name.
defects.actual_result: effective_ar becomes 'شركة النور ذ.م.م Sole Proprietorship' because string.replace() looked for English 'LLC' and appended English 'Sole Proprietorship' to Arabic text.
defects.root_cause: Line 149 uses effective_ar.replace(old_legal_form) where old_legal_form is English token, and line 153 appends new_legal_form without Arabic translation mapping.
defects.recommended_action: Use bilingual legal form dictionary mapping (e.g. {'LLC': 'ذ.م.م', 'Sole Proprietorship': 'مؤسسة فردية'}) to strip and append corresponding language tokens.
